title: NoiseBank
description: Low-amplitude (quiet) bipolar EGM segments used as additive noise by the synthetic-EGM mixer. Schema version 1.0. Intentionally minimal: only the fields the mixer actually consumes are required here. Extraction provenance (calibration scheme, threshold strategy, filter band, per-trace metadata) lives in a sibling noise_bank_run_record.json file. The convention is the same as metrics.csv + run.json in egm-classifier: the two files are written together with matching name stems and the consumer that needs methods opens the sibling.

schema_version.description: Schema version in X.Y form. X (major) bumps at release; Y (minor) bumps on every dev-time structural change. Consumers MUST refuse unknown major versions.

created_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp captured at write time.

source.description: Free-form provenance tag identifying the upstream dataset (e.g., 'iafdb v1.0.0'). Producers stamp this; consumers read it to decide whether banks from different sources are mixable. Not an enum so new datasets can show up without a schema bump.

fs_hz.description: Sampling rate in Hz. The mixer asserts that this matches the synthetic side's fs and refuses to mix if it doesn't.

traces.description: Per-trace columns. Maps to the HDF5 `traces/` group. All columns have first dimension N (the segment count) and are aligned.

signal.description: (N, T) float32 — band-pass-filtered bipolar window. The only column the mixer's math reads.

source_record.description: (N,) UTF-8 — Source-dataset record identifier (e.g., 'iaf1_afw' for IAFDB). The mixer copies this onto each output trace as an audit field; downstream debugging can trace a hybrid sample back to the source noise.

source_channel.description: (N,) UTF-8 — Bipolar channel name within the source record (e.g., 'CS12' for IAFDB). Same audit-propagation role as source_record.
